q_body: I'm currently trying to build an application that calculates possible outcomes for a sports league. Say I have a league with 9 Teams and there are 8 games left to play. I want to be able to determine the probabilty that any of these 9 teams finishes within a certain range (e.g. Team B finishes top 3). The code I came up with was highly inspired by this post ( Calculating probability of a Fantasy League in Python ) I'm initially reading the current standings from a csv file and then calculate all possible outcomes. Games are best of 5 sets, so there are six diferent possible results for each game: 3:0, 3:1, 3:2, 0:3, 1:3, 2:3. I need to keep track of all of them because if, after playing all games, two teams have the same amout of points, the number of sets won decides whos ahead. Up until now, however, I only calculated all possible outcomes without adjusting the ranking accordingly. Now the problem is that with there being 8 games with 6 possible outcomes i get about 1.7 million possible scenarios and the calculation would take roughly 50 minutes (estimated by the time it took to calculate 100k results.
